notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091012/5d2a6c98fb32ca57fdd743ff5ca900dcbb3f7780.png


 Acorn throwing distance has been doubled.

notes.notes:
Better First Time Setup accessibility.
 UI improvements. 
 Added more assistance during tutorial stages.
